chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Abu Abdillah al-Barqi, from Ali ibn Mahziyar and Abu Ali ibn Rashid, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:

"Among the treasures of the knowledge of God is perfection in four places: the Sanctuary of God, the Sanctuary of His Messenger, the Sanctuary of the Commander of the Faithful, and the Sanctuary of al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him)."

key_terms.مَخْزُونِ عِلْمِ اللَّهِ: Treasures of the knowledge of God

ai.seo_question: What are the four sanctuaries where perfection of knowledge is found according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In the context of expiation for ritual breaches, this hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib* identifies four 'sanctuaries' (Haram) where divine knowledge is perfected: the Kaaba, the Prophet, Imam Ali, and Imam al-Husayn. This triad of Imams alongside the Prophet reflects the Shia concept of *Haramiyyah*, linking the physical sanctity of the Kaaba with the spiritual authority of the Ahl al-Bayt as the ultimate centers of religious perfection.
